sentences.text: The policy materials mention credit cards and “penal charges, if any, in case of delayed payment,” but they do not state any specific late payment fee amount for credit card dues in the provided materials.
The UCB directions also say the policy shall clearly lay down the liability of the bank by way of interest payments due to delays, but they do not provide a fee amount here.
